Goal references use your current explicit goals. Missing goals are not replaced with defaults. Complete entry coverage does not prove a complete day’s intake.

Food calories minus recorded manual/guided exercise estimates. No logged exercise contributes zero recorded exercise to this arithmetic; it does not mean zero physical activity. Resting metabolism and other activity are excluded. This is not a calorie surplus or deficit, and exercise does not automatically change your food goal.
